en2zh.out:
翻译结果：

I didn't sleep well last night. So I'm feeling a bit drowsy today.

en2zh.src: The food at this restaurant is delicious, but it's a bit pricey.
en2zh.out:
译文:  
The food at the restaurant is delicious, but it's a bit expensive.

en2zh.src: Just leave the package at the door, I'll pick it up after work.
en2zh.out:
译文：  
Just leave the package at the door, I'll pick it up after work.

en2zh.src: The kids need to finish their homework before they can watch TV.
en2zh.out:
翻译成中文的译文是：

The kids need to finish their homework before they can watch TV.

en2zh.src: The doctor suggested I drink at least eight glasses of water a day.
en2zh.out: 译文：医生建议每天至少喝8杯水。

en2zh.src: Could you please turn down the air conditioning a little? Thanks.
en2zh.out: 译文：请稍等一下，谢谢。

en2zh.src: We're having a meeting at 10 a.m. next Wednesday to discuss the launch plan for the new product.
en2zh.out:
译文:  
我们将在接下来的一周周三下午一点召开会议，以讨论新产品的发布计划。

en2zh.src: This server supports horizontal scaling, so you can increase overall throughput by adding nodes.
en2zh.out: 这个服务器支持水平扩展，因此，你可以通过添加服务器来提高整体的吞吐量。

en2zh.src: After deployment, please run a smoke test first to make sure all the APIs return correctly.
en2zh.out: After deployment, please run a smoke test first to ensure all APIs are working correctly.

en2zh.src: The default database connection pool size is ten, and you can adjust it based on concurrency.
en2zh.out:
译文:  
默认数据库连接池大小为10，可以根据并发情况进行调整。

en2zh.src: The algorithm has a time complexity of O(n log n) and performs well on large datasets.
en2zh.out: 译文：算法具有O(n^log n)的时间复杂度，并在大型数据集的情况下表现良好。

en2zh.src: Make sure HTTPS is enabled in production and that certificates are renewed regularly.
en2zh.out: 译文: 请确保生产环境中启用HTTPS，并且证书应定期更换。

en2zh.src: There are three common cache invalidation strategies: time-based, active, and passive.
en2zh.out: 译文：有三种常见的无效策略：时间，active和passive。

en2zh.src: This software is open source under the Apache 2.0 license and is free for commercial use.
en2zh.out:
翻译如下内容为中文：

此软件是基于 Apache 2.0 标签的开源软件，并且适用于商业用途。

en2zh.src: Containerized deployment ensures consistency between development and production environments.
en2zh.out: Containerized deployment ensures the consistency between development and production environments.

en2zh.src: Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
en2zh.out: 译文：不要把鸟先孵化后飞出。

en2zh.src: It's not rocket science — anyone can learn it in an afternoon.
en2zh.out: 它不是一项需要花费一小时的时间来学习的内容。

en2zh.src: We're putting all our eggs in one basket, and that worries me.
en2zh.out: 译文：我们把所有的努力都放在这个篮子里，这让我感到很欣慰。

en2zh.src: The manager hit the nail on the head when he said our biggest problem is communication.
en2zh.out:
译文:  
The manager hit the head when he said the biggest problem is communication.

en2zh.src: Don't beat around the bush — just tell me what you really think.
en2zh.out: 译文：Don't just tell me what you think — don't just tell me what you think.

en2zh.src: That explanation is a piece of cake compared to what's coming next.
en2zh.out:
翻译结果：

That explanation is a piece of cake compared to what's coming next.

en2zh.src: She spilled the beans about the surprise party before it happened.
en2zh.out: 译文：她分享了关于那意外的惊喜聚会的趣事。

en2zh.src: Every cloud has a silver lining.
en2zh.out: 译文：每有阴影，每有光明。

en2zh.src: Although the team faced a dual challenge of funding shortages and staff turnover over the past few months, they still completed the prototype on schedule.
en2zh.out: 翻译成中文后的内容是：虽然过去几个月，团队面临资金短缺和员工流失的问题，但仍然按时完成了原型。

en2zh.src: As extreme weather events caused by climate change become increasingly frequent, many coastal cities have had to reassess the design standards of their infrastructure.
en2zh.out:
翻译如下：

As extreme weather events caused by climate change have become increasingly frequent, many coastal cities have to reassess the design standards of their infrastructure.

en2zh.src: The report warns that if no stricter emission cuts are adopted, global average temperatures could rise by more than two degrees Celsius by the end of the century, with irreversible ecological consequences.
en2zh.out:
翻译如下：

报告警告，如果在世纪末不采取更严格的排放降低，全球平均温度将可能上升超过两度，这将导致不可预测的生态后果。

en2zh.src: The author explains the basic principles of quantum computing in plain language, making the book a delightful read even for readers without a physics background.
en2zh.out: 译文: 作者解释了量子计算的基本原理，使书籍内容对于无物理背景的读者来说也显得非常有趣。

en2zh.src: The company spokesperson said at the press conference that the recall only affects specific batches, and consumers can exchange the product free of charge at any store with a receipt.
en2zh.out:
译文：  
公司发言人表示，在当时，只有特定批次的召回，而消费者可以在有相关 receipts 的商店获得免费产品。

en2zh.src: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, how to improve efficiency while protecting user privacy has become a question the whole industry must face.
en2zh.out:
译文：  
与人工智能的快速发展有关，如何提高效率同时保护用户隐私的问题已成为整个行业必须面对的问题。

en2zh.src: Although the online-offline integrated retail model has become an irresistible trend, many traditional companies are still struggling with digital transformation.
en2zh.out: 译文：虽然在线与离线的整合零售模式已变成一种不可忽视的潮流，许多传统公司仍然在面临数字化转型的困难。

en2zh.src: The Ministry of Education issued a notice this week requiring schools not to publish student exam rankings in any form, in order to ease students' psychological pressure.
en2zh.out: 中文译文：教育部门在本周要求中小学不发布任何形式的考试排名信息，以减轻学生的情绪压力。

en2zh.src: Hang in there — it'll get better soon.
en2zh.out: 译文：它将很快变得更优秀。

en2zh.src: I'm broke until payday, so let's just grab something cheap.
en2zh.out: I'm not on the day, so let's just get something cheap.

en2zh.src: That new series is totally binge-worthy; I finished it in two days.
en2zh.out: 译文：那新系列是完全的，我只用了两天就完成了。

en2zh.src: He ghosted me after the second date — no text, nothing.
en2zh.out: 译文：他在第二天与对方约会 — 无内容。

en2zh.src: This coffee hits different when it's freshly brewed.
en2zh.out: 这咖啡在喝咖啡时，喝咖啡时，咖啡的香气会带来。

en2zh.src: Don't worry about the deadline, we'll figure it out as we go.
en2zh.out: 译文: 请不要担心时间，我们将尽快解决。

en2zh.src: My boss keeps throwing around buzzwords like "synergy" in every meeting.
en2zh.out: 译文：我的同事经常在会议上经常提到“协作”这样的词汇。

en2zh.src: Honestly, that idea is just noise — it won't get us anywhere.
en2zh.out:
翻译如下：

当然，这种想法只是噪音，它不会带你去目的地。
